title: Coles, Woolies, TCN All Hacked?
body:
Anyone reckon the recent Coles, Woolies, TCN gift card app has all been hacked by the same group at the same time?
Coles database
Woolies gift cards drained
TCN app not working
Blackhawk probably will be next but they never have had good control. Prepaid centre sucks too and some cards need to email to check balance.
Just all seem to be happening at the same time.
Don't even know if we should be buying these TCN 15% coming up at Coles
*Looks like there is a good number of energy and insurance reward programs that issue gift cards are down as well.
